summary: Keep terminal attachments connected during large replay and distinguish connection loss from child exit.

replay.detail: No stored claim replay or projection recovery change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule change.

compatibility.detail: An attachment socket closing without an EXIT frame now reports connection loss and exits 1 instead of claiming that the session ended successfully. Successful detach and received child exit statuses are unchanged. The bundled server bounds outbound memory rather than packet count and can send a best-effort rejection reason understood by the embedded client.

manual.detail: Installing binaries does not upgrade already-running terminal server processes. Apply the server correction only through a separately coordinated handoff that preserves running sessions; do not restart a live session solely to acquire this update.

recovery.detail: No persisted migration or store repair. Binary rollback restores the older attachment behavior.

downtime.detail: Any required process handoff is separately coordinated. Its duration and interruption behavior have not been measured by this change.
